description: E3: an oath-stone of the Kingsward, a standing stone of the old giant kings with an iron collar near its head: one of the Hollow King's oath-chains is made fast to it and runs into his shell. While one stands, a plate torn from him is drawn back onto him; brought down by a giant's blows it snaps at half its height and its chain with it - he reels (HollowEnemy). One use: it stays down.
